## About
Kip Sheehan learned to paint cars by watching. As a teenager sweeping floors and taking out the trash, he studied the painters and waited for his day. When it didn't come, he bought his own car, a Pontiac Lemans, popped out the dents himself and painted it canary yellow one quiet weekend. It turned out perfectly.
He went on to open his own collision shop, later ran Margate Paint and Body, and then moved to Boca Raton to open Sheehan's Collision. His loyal customers came with him. Along the way Kip has built long-lasting friendships, and he's still making a living doing what he loves.
Today you'll find Kip in the shop and Teresa keeping customers informed from drop-off to pickup. We hold a 4.9 rating from 148 Google reviews, and we serve Boca Raton and South Palm Beach County.

## Services
- Collision & Repair: Bumpers, fenders, side damage and paint. We'll work our Sheehan magic so your car looks as good as new when we're done.
- Insurance Work: We work with more than a dozen insurance companies. Don't fret. We'll walk you through the process.
- Free Rental Cars Available: Free rental vehicles while your car is being repaired, so you can stay on the road.
- Free Estimate: Bring your car by or reach out to get started with a free estimate.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: We work with more than a dozen insurance companies, and we'll walk you through the process.

Q: Can I get a rental car while my car is in the shop?
A: Yes. Free rental vehicles are provided during your repair, available only at our collision center.

Q: Do you stand behind your repairs?
A: Yes. We guarantee a lifetime warranty on our work.

Q: What days are you open?
A: We're open Monday to Saturday.
